description: The chart, labeled Figure 7, illustrates the average rate at which a model attends to different input segments during generation. The horizontal axis represents the input segments, labeled as "context", "generated response", and "other", although the exact labels on the x-axis are not visible. The vertical axis is labeled but the label is not visible, and it has a linear scale ranging from 0 to an unspecified upper limit. The chart features three bars for each input segment, colored blue, gray, and purple, representing "Standard", "CInGS (w/) ", and "CInGS", respectively, as indicated by the legend. The blue, gray, and purple bars are grouped together for each input segment, with the blue bar being the tallest for "context", and the purple bar being the shortest for "context" but the tallest for "generated response". The exact values are not discernible, but the chart shows that the model attends most to "context" when using "Standard", and most to "generated response" when using "CInGS". The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
